answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3436 Country: TZ Title: I want to ask about chast hair removing. Any muslim man allowed remove his chast hair?Muslman mard ko chest key baal shave karne ki ijazat he? Question: Assalam alaiku. I want to ask about chast hair removing. Any muslim man allowed remove his chast hair?Muslman mard ko chest key baal shave karne ki ijazat he? Answer ID: 3436 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 253/242=J) It is against etiquettes to shave hair of chest; therefore it should be avoided: و فی حلق شعر الصدر والظھر ترک الأ دب Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
